report.markdown:
# First Moon Landing

## Mission and Year

One source reports that humans first landed on the surface of the Moon with the Apollo 11 mission in July 1969. [1][2]

## Sources

1. [Moon - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon) — wikipedia.org, published 2001-11-05, fetched 2026-10-31
2. [Space Race - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Space_Race) — wikipedia.org, published 2002-09-12, fetched 2026-10-31
